rows.text: There shall be written procedures describing in sufficient detail the receipt, identification, storage, handling, sampling, examination, and/or testing of labeling and packaging materials; such written procedures shall be followed.

passages.text:
1. Purpose

To prevent mix-ups of labels and products on the packaging lines by controlling how labels are stored and issued and how each line is cleared and checked.

2. Scope

Applies to the four blister and bottle lines in the packaging hall.

3. Label storage and issue

3.1 Approved labels are kept in the locked label store, each version separately. 3.2 The store keeper issues the number of labels stated on the packaging order and records the quantity on the order. 3.3 After packing, the labels used, damaged and returned are counted; if the count does not match the number issued beyond the limit on the order, the difference is investigated before the batch is released. 3.4 Excess labels bearing a batch number are destroyed and the destruction is recorded.

rows.text: Labeling and packaging materials shall be representatively sampled, and examined or tested upon receipt and before use in packaging or labeling of a drug product.

passages.text:
1. Purpose

To prevent mix-ups of labels and products on the packaging lines by controlling how labels are stored and issued and how each line is cleared and checked.

3. Label storage and issue

3.1 Approved labels are kept in the locked label store, each version separately. 3.2 The store keeper issues the number of labels stated on the packaging order and records the quantity on the order. 3.3 After packing, the labels used, damaged and returned are counted; if the count does not match the number issued beyond the limit on the order, the difference is investigated before the batch is released. 3.4 Excess labels bearing a batch number are destroyed and the destruction is recorded.

4.1 Before a new batch is started, the line is cleared of all products, labels and packaging materials of the previous batch. 4.2 The supervisor inspects the line and signs the clearance checklist on the packaging record. 4.3 Only one product is packed on a line at a time, and each line carries a board showing the product name and batch being packed.
